metadata.title: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information 문제은행
metadata.source: Jeppesen Airway Manual, Radio Data - General, General Information, pp.331–335
metadata.scope_note: p.331–335 only; Section 1 Navigation Aids begins at p.336.

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information
questions.question: Jeppesen General Information에서 VLF(Very Low Frequency)의 범위는?
questions.explanation: 원문은 VLF를 0–30 kHz로 분류한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.331

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information
questions.question: LF(Low Frequency)의 범위로 맞는 것은?
questions.explanation: 원문은 LF를 30 kHz–300 kHz로 분류한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.331

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information
questions.question: HF(High Frequency)의 범위는?
questions.explanation: 원문은 HF를 3 MHz–30 MHz로 분류한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.331

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information
questions.question: Jeppesen 표에서 VHF(Very High Frequency)의 일반 범위는?
questions.explanation: 원문 frequency bands 표에서 VHF는 30 MHz–300 MHz이다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.331

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information
questions.question: Jeppesen의 Aviation 주석에 따르면 UHF로 간주되는 범위는?
questions.explanation: 원문 주석은 Aviation에서 200 MHz–3 GHz를 UHF로 간주한다고 명시한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.331

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information
questions.question: 모든 VHF marker(FAN TYPE, OUTER, INNER, ZONE)가 운용되는 주파수는?
questions.explanation: 원문은 모든 VHF marker가 75 MHz(75,000 kHz)에서 운용된다고 설명한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.331

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information
questions.question: Outer Marker(OM)의 tone modulation은?
questions.explanation: 원문 marker tone 표에서 OM(Outer Marker)은 400 Hz이다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.331

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information
questions.question: Middle Marker(MM)의 tone modulation은?
questions.explanation: 원문 marker tone 표에서 MM(Middle Marker)은 1300 Hz이다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.331

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information
questions.question: 표준 NDB(Non-directional Beacon)의 일반 주파수 범위는?
questions.explanation: 원문은 standard NDB를 190–1750 kHz로 제시한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.332

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information
questions.question: ILS localizer의 주파수 범위는?
questions.explanation: 원문은 ILS localizer를 108.0–111.975 MHz로 제시하며 odd-tenths plus twentieth frequencies를 사용한다고 설명한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.332

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information
questions.question: ILS glide slope의 주파수 범위는?
questions.explanation: 원문 frequency allocation에서 ILS glide slope는 328.6–335.4 MHz이다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.332

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information
questions.question: DME와 TACAN의 주파수 범위는?
questions.explanation: 원문은 DME and TACAN을 960.0–1215.0 MHz로 제시한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.332

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information
questions.question: Jeppesen 표에서 GPS에 할당된 범위는?
questions.explanation: 원문은 GPS를 1563.42–1587.42 MHz로 제시한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.332

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information
questions.question: 500 kHz에 대한 설명으로 맞는 것은?

choices.text: International frequency for aircraft and ships over the seas이다.

questions.explanation: 원문은 500 kHz를 aircraft and ships over the seas를 위한 international frequency로 설명한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.332

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information
questions.question: 500 kHz에서는 긴급·안전 전문 등을 제외하고 매시간 언제부터 3분간 일반 송신을 중지해야 하는가?
questions.explanation: 원문은 매시간 15분과 45분부터 각각 3분간 송신을 중지한다고 설명한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.332

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information
questions.question: Aeronautical mobile (R) service에서 assignable frequency의 최소 분리 간격은?
questions.explanation: 원문은 minimum separation between assignable frequencies를 8.33 kHz로 제시한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.332

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information
questions.question: 121.6–121.9917 MHz 구간의 용도는?

choices.text: International and National Aerodrome Surface Communications

questions.explanation: 원문은 121.6–121.9917 MHz를 International and National Aerodrome Surface Communications로 제시한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.333

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information
questions.question: Auxiliary frequency SAR로 제시된 주파수는?
questions.explanation: 원문은 123.1 MHz를 Auxiliary frequency SAR로 제시한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.333

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information
questions.question: Worldwide air-to-air communications 주파수는?
questions.explanation: 원문은 123.45 MHz를 Worldwide air-to-air communications로 명시한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.333

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information
questions.question: 136.9–136.975 MHz는 무엇을 위해 reserved되어 있는가?
questions.explanation: 원문은 136.9–136.975 MHz를 VHF air-ground data link communications용으로 reserved한다고 설명한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.333

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information
questions.question: VHF transmission의 정상적인 range는 실제 line of sight와 비교해 대략 어떠한가?
questions.explanation: 원문은 VHF transmission range가 actual line of sight보다 normally about 7% more라고 설명한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.333

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information
questions.question: VHF range 공식에서 D가 의미하는 것은?
questions.explanation: 원문에서 D는 distance in nautical miles를 의미한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.333

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information
questions.question: VHF range 공식에서 h가 feet로 표현될 때 K 값은?
questions.explanation: 원문은 h가 feet일 때 K=1.23이라고 제시한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.333

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information
questions.question: VHF range 공식에서 h가 metres로 표현될 때 K 값은?
questions.explanation: 원문은 h가 metres일 때 K=2.22라고 제시한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.333

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information

subunit.title: VHF Range Reference & Signal Emissions I

questions.question: 평탄한 지형에서 항공기 고도 500 ft일 때 Jeppesen 표의 VHF range는?
questions.explanation: 원문 표에서 500 ft의 VHF range는 28 NM이다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.334

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information

subunit.title: VHF Range Reference & Signal Emissions I

questions.question: 평탄한 지형에서 5,000 ft의 VHF range는?
questions.explanation: 원문 표에서 5,000 ft의 VHF range는 87 NM이다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.334

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information

subunit.title: VHF Range Reference & Signal Emissions I

questions.question: 평탄한 지형에서 10,000 ft의 VHF range는?
questions.explanation: 원문 표에서 10,000 ft의 VHF range는 122 NM이다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.334

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information

subunit.title: VHF Range Reference & Signal Emissions I

questions.question: 평탄한 지형에서 40,000 ft의 VHF range는?
questions.explanation: 원문 표에서 40,000 ft의 VHF range는 246 NM이다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.334

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information

subunit.title: VHF Range Reference & Signal Emissions I

questions.question: Signal emission designation A1A(구 A1)의 transmission type은?

choices.text: Telegraphy without the use of a modulating audio frequency

questions.explanation: 원문은 A1A(A1)를 modulating audio frequency를 사용하지 않는 telegraphy(on-off keying)로 설명한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.334

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information

subunit.title: VHF Range Reference & Signal Emissions I

questions.question: A3A(구 A3)의 특징은?
questions.explanation: 원문 Types of Signal Emissions 표에서 A3A(A3)는 Telephony, Double Sideband이다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.334

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information

subunit.title: VHF Range Reference & Signal Emissions I

questions.question: J3E(구 A3J)의 특징은?
questions.explanation: 원문은 J3E(A3J)를 Single sideband, suppressed carrier로 제시한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.334

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information

subunit.title: VHF Range Reference & Signal Emissions I

questions.question: H3E(구 A3H)의 특징은?

choices.text: Two independent sidebands containing digital information

questions.explanation: 원문은 H3E(A3H)를 Single sideband, full carrier로 제시한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.334

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information
questions.question: R3E(구 A3A)의 특징은?
questions.explanation: 원문은 R3E(A3A)를 Single sideband, reduced carrier로 제시한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.334

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information
questions.question: B7E의 특징은?

choices.text: 두 독립 sideband에 quantized/digital information 포함
두 독립 sideband에 analogue information 포함

questions.explanation: 원문은 B7E를 two independent sidebands containing quantized or digital information으로 설명한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.334

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information
questions.question: B8E의 특징은?

choices.text: Two independent sidebands containing analogue information

questions.explanation: 원문은 B8E를 two independent sidebands containing analogue information으로 설명한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.334

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information
questions.question: A4(구 A4)의 transmission type은?
questions.explanation: 원문은 A4를 Facsimile(by a frequency modulated sub-carrier)로 제시한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.334

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information
questions.question: R3C(구 A4A)의 특징은?
questions.explanation: 원문 p.335에서 R3C(A4A)는 Single sideband, reduced carrier이다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.335

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information
questions.question: J3C의 특징은?
questions.explanation: 원문 p.335에서 J3C는 Single sideband, suppressed carrier이다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.335

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information
questions.question: R7B(구 A7A)의 transmission type/특징 조합으로 맞는 것은?

choices.text: Multichannel voice-frequency telegraphy / Single sideband, reduced carrier

questions.explanation: 원문은 R7B(A7A)를 Multichannel voice-frequency telegraphy, Single sideband, reduced carrier로 제시한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.335

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information
questions.question: B9W(구 A9B)에 대한 설명으로 맞는 것은?

choices.text: 위 분류에 포함되지 않는 조합(예: telephony+telegraphy), two independent sidebands

questions.explanation: 원문은 B9W(A9B)를 위 항목으로 포괄되지 않는 경우(예: telephony와 telegraphy의 조합), two independent sidebands로 설명한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · General Information p.335
